speaker: Doctor
text:
Good morning, I see you have a concerning skin lesion; can you tell me how long it has been present and if you've noticed any changes in its size, color, or shape?

Also, have you experienced any bleeding, itching, or pain in that specific area?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is a very concerning presentation, especially given your age, smoking history, and the chronic, non-healing nature of these lesions despite previous treatments. Have you noticed any specific changes in the texture of the lesions, such as becoming hard, raised, or ulcerated, and do you have any known history of HPV or HIV?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, HIV Serology, Syphilis Serology (RPR/FTA-ABS).
REQUEST IMAGES: High-resolution dermoscopic images of the penile and digital lesions.

speaker: Measurement
text:
RESULTS: 
Vital_Signs: Temperature 36.8°C (98.2°F), Blood_Pressure 130/85 mmHg, Heart_Rate 82 bpm, Respiratory_Rate 14 breaths/min.
Dermatological_Examination_Inspection: Erythematous plaque with areas of crusting, oozing, and irregular borders on the dorsal surface of the penile shaft and left middle finger.
Dermatological_Examination_Palpation: Lesions firm, non-tender, no warmth.
Dermatological_Examination_Regional_Lymph_Nodes: No palpable cervical, axillary, or inguinal lymphadenopathy.
Biopsy_Findings: Cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within the follicle-bearing epithelium.
STD_Panel_Syphilis: Negative.
STD_Panel_HIV: Negative

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Non-healing, crusty, red lesions on the penile shaft and left middle finger. I also have Lesions are painless, History of unsuccessful treatment for syphilis and eczema. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Penile and Digit)
